description: ADR-0032 Phase 0 pilot: the critical seeded faults of core, robust and curve, conventional mutants, and one example of each non-scoring outcome.

mutants.diagnostic: robust: the orientation grid of Kettner et al. is decided exactly

mutants.contract: ADR-0002: Orient2D's sign is that of the determinant
mutants.diagnostic: robust: predicates agree with exact integer arithmetic on random points

mutants.contract: ADR-0004: a handle to a removed entity is stale and detected

return index < m_Generations.size() && m_Alive[index] &&

mutants.diagnostic: core: generation tables detect stale handles

mutants.operator: relational: closed lower bound made open
mutants.contract: ADR-0001/ADR-0028: intervals are closed; a value on the boundary is contained
mutants.diagnostic: core: intervals are closed and may be empty

mutants.contract: ADR-0016 (standing in for ADR-0018's checker): a knot inside the domain repeated more than the degree is rejected
mutants.diagnostic: curve: MakeBSplineCurve validates data from outside the kernel

mutants.operator: relational: <= to < at the frame allowance
mutants.contract: ADR-0028: FrameAllowance admits a frame whose error equals it

mutants.operator: arithmetic: + to - in the Cox-de Boor recurrence
mutants.contract: B-spline basis functions (The NURBS Book, A2.2)

mutants.operator: relational: >= to > in the span search

mutants.contract: Curve projection searches segments in order of their distance bound
mutants.equivalent: A segment whose lower bound equals the best squared distance can at best tie it, and a tie keeps the earlier parameter (ADR-0007), which the search already holds unless the tied point has a smaller parameter in a later segment; segments are ordered by bound, not parameter, so the result can differ only in an exact tie of distances between two segments, which the supported semantics leave to either answer. Expert review: no observable difference within the declared semantics.

mutants.operator: demonstration: a mutant that does not build
mutants.contract: Reporting: a build failure is Invalid, not a kill

mutants.operator: demonstration: a mutant that never terminates
mutants.contract: Reporting: a timeout is Inconclusive, not a kill
